notes: Original experimental paper (Carbon 48 (2010) 2722-2733); record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice found in the text. H2 uptake measured at 77 K (DMT high-pressure microbalance, buoyancy-corrected, up to 40 bar; Section 2.7, p. 4) and at 298 K (automatic volumetric apparatus, up to 20 MPa). Sorbents are KOH-activated carbon xerogels with Ni loadings of 2.5-9.7 wt% (ICP, Table 5, p. 6), so carbon is the majority component. The text layer drops the minus sign of -196 C; the page images (pp. 4, 9) show it. The 6 wt% / 31.8 g/L figures in the abstract are total (adsorbed plus compressed) capacities calculated in Figs. 10-11; the measured excess isotherms (Figs. 7, 9) are the uptake data. TPD (Figs. 6, 8) is additional and not what meets I1. Fig. 9 text cites the authors' earlier work [42] for agreement only; no statement that all uptake values were previously published, so duplicate_data does not apply.
